contract: A23-86: Deeds = one cap a KST day (6 points) for every repeated Honor / Infamy change, +1 own side / -1 other side with a 0 floor, a lost rank reported, a full day keeps the reward, DeedsToday / DeedsMax attributes, back to 0 at 00:00 KST, repaired save data.Deeds { Day, N }; ChoiceCard = a card only the player sees (Config.ChoiceCard.Kinds), Good and Evil of the same size with a FIXED reward, one open card a player, saved cards wait with no limit and come back at the next join (data.Cards { Serial, Pending }), timed cards are not saved (time up = None), c->s CardAction(id, side) validated and rate limited, gold source 'Choice', overflow items paid at the sell price, points only through Deeds.Add, every pick counted in data.Story.N[kind][side], Fx Card / CardEnd, signal Picked.
limitations: The card screen is client work (game dev 1). The real card kinds (lost items, apprentice, clatter) and the Finisher migration come with their content; the test kinds are injected. My Way does not read Story.N yet (the weight is decided: 5 repeated picks = 1 story pick, capped).
